facts.fact: The document says the 10-year Tanzania Digital Economy Strategy Framework 'has been launched' by the President of Tanzania, Dr. Samia Suluhu Hassan, on 29 July 2024; no cabinet or parliamentary act is named.

The document calls the Tanzania Digital Economy Strategy Framework a '10-year' strategy launched on 29 July 2024, so its period runs to about 2034 and has not ended; it gives no start and end years. Text public: not stated

The document says the government, through the Tanzania Business Council, created a Digital Transformation Committee of public and private members for driving the digital economy strategy; it gives no date for the committee, so the document's publication month is used.
